title.zh: 台湾封锁Coinbase与Kalshi网站，指其涉嫌违反选举博彩规定
title.en: 【台湾封禁 Coinbase 和 Kalshi，理由是涉嫌参与选举投注】

current_state.zh: Taiwanese authorities, acting on a court order from New Taipei, blocked access to Coinbase and Kalshi over alleged violations of election-gambling laws ahead of the November 28 local elections, with users reporting loss of access since Wednesday and Polymarket already blocked in the region.
current_state.en: Taiwanese authorities, acting on a court order from New Taipei, blocked access to Coinbase and Kalshi over alleged violations of election-gambling laws ahead of the November 28 local elections, with users reporting loss of access since Wednesday and Polymarket already blocked in the region.
